turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patil?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Patil. Who is this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste sir, this is Sneha calling from City Care Hospital in Mumbai. I am calling about your cardiology reports.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, the heart tests. Are they ready? I was waiting for the call.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, the reports have arrived and the doctor has reviewed them. We have scheduled your follow-up appointment for Tuesday at 10 AM.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Tuesday... let me check my diary. Yes, that should be fine, but is it something serious?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not worry sir, the doctor just wants to discuss the results in person. You can collect the hard copy of the report from the reception when you arrive.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. Will there be any more charges for this visit?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The total outstanding for the tests and consultation comes to twenty five thousand rupees. You can just settle the bill at the counter on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twenty five thousand? My goodness, it has become so expensive. I will bring the cheque book.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is perfectly fine sir. We will see you on Tuesday at 10 AM then.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay beta, thank you for informing me. Goodbye.
